title.zh: 将位于达沃市碧瑶区塔万塔万描笼涯的Tawantawan小学更名为Rosalia Aglay Ayag小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Tawantawan Elementary School in Barangay Tawantawan, Baguio District, Davao City to Rosalia Aglay Ayag Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Tawantawan Elementary School in Barangay Tawantawan, Baguio District, Davao City to Rosalia Aglay Ayag Elementary School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11173_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: - The name of Tawantawan Elementary School in Barangay Tawantawan, Baguio District, Davao City is hereby changed to Rosalia "Aglay" Ayag Elementary School.
- The main campus of the Rosalia "Aglay" Ayag Elementary School shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Tawantawan, Baguio District, Davao City.
- The act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
